title: Tag ruleset on the six repositories, so a published version can never move or vanish (CI owns the version: the editor's setting)
note: Dev, 27 October 2026. CI now numbers every release of the six (press v1.0.58, data v0.1.52, team, site, refs and updates v0.22.39 were the first): it writes VERSION in a GitHub Actions commit and tags it. A tag is the published version, so it must never be moved or deleted. On GitHub: the SGit-AI organization, Settings, Repository, Rulesets, New ruleset, New tag ruleset. Name: published versions. Enforcement: Active. Target repositories: by name, SGit-AI__Website__Newsroom__2026__Oct__PHP__* (the six; v1 too, harmless). Target tags: include by pattern v*. Rules: Restrict updates, Restrict deletions (leave Restrict creations off: CI creates them). Bypass list: none. Optional, if the plan offers push rulesets: a push ruleset restricting the file path VERSION, with GitHub Actions as the only bypass, so the guard holds at the push itself.
